pages.text: The $(d)Eat Grass$() Gene lets players eat Grass Blocks with an empty hand, restoring 1 hunger and 1 saturation. Grass and Mycelium become Dirt; Nylium becomes Netherrack.$(br2)This Gene $(c)cannot be given to mobs$().
These are the default chances. Modpacks may change them.$(br2)3/15 - Cow$(br)3/15 - Goat$(br)4/13 - Mooshroom$(br)3/12 - Sheep
